info.description:
## Quickstart

### 1. Obtain an access token

Obtain an access token, for example with an API key ([Authenticate via API Key](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/AuthenticateAPIKey)).
Generate API credentials in the alfaview administration to get an API key, as the support article [Generate API credentials](https://support.alfaview.com/en/for-it-administration/advanced-configurations/generate-api-credentials/) describes.

```shell
curl -X POST https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/auth/api-key \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"companyId": "<company ID>", "clientId": "<API key alias>", "key": "<API key>"}'
```

The response contains the token: `{"accessToken": "<base64-encoded token>"}`.

### 2. Call the API with the token

Pass the token with the `Bearer` prefix in the `Authorization` header of every further request, for example to list the rooms ([List Rooms](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/ListRooms)):

```shell
curl https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/rooms -H "Authorization: Bearer <base64-encoded token>"
```

## Format information

* All time fields are returned in RFC3339 format and in UTC if not mentioned otherwise.

## Pagination

List endpoints are paginated. They return at most `limit` items (default and maximum depend on the endpoint, see its `limit` parameter) and a `nextPageToken` if more items exist.
To obtain the next page, repeat the request with the `pageToken` parameter set to that value. The last page contains no `nextPageToken`.

## Errors

Errors are returned as `application/problem+json` ([RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457)) with the fields `title`, `status` and `detail`, and an optional `errors` list with the `location`, `message` and `value` of each individual validation error.

A request that does not match the schema of the endpoint gets the response code `422`. This is the case when a required field or parameter is missing, a value has the wrong type or format or is out of range, or the body contains an unknown field.
Additional cases are documented for each endpoint individually.

`401` responses of endpoints that require an access token additionally carry the header `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`.

## Authentication

### API Key and Credentials

All API requests require an access token for authorization. Access tokens can be obtained by authenticating using any of the following endpoints:
- [Authenticate via API key](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/AuthenticateAPIKey)
- [Authenticate via password](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/AuthenticatePassword)
- [Authenticate a guest (guest link)](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/AuthenticateGuestLink)
- [Authenticate a guest (group link)](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/AuthenticateGroupLink)
The access token is returned as a base64-encoded string. It needs to be sent in the `Authorization` header in all subsequent API requests, with an optional `Bearer ` prefix (`Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `Authorization: <token>`).

### Token Time-To-Live (TTL)

Access tokens are valid for 1 hour. After this period, tokens will be expired and a new token must be obtained.

## Permissions

The description of every endpoint states the user permissions and room permissions it requires. There are two distinct types of permissions that can be applied to users independently.

### Room permissions

Room permissions are the permissions of users in a particular room. If users have no permissions for a room, they cannot get any information about the room and it is excluded from room lists. The main exceptions are users with the user permission `roomAdmin`. [List Rooms](https://apis.alfaview.com/v2/docs/openapi#/operations/ListRooms) states the exact rules.

To edit room properties or create resources (e.g., links, subrooms) for a room, users need room administrator permissions or user permissions that permit those actions.
For further information please refer to the [room permissions section in the support center](https://support.alfaview.com/en/administration/general/room-permissions/).

### User permissions

User permissions are high level permissions applied to users independently from specific rooms.

- with `emailAddress`, otherwise: no user other than the caller

**Restrictions:**
- guest access token with `emailAddress`: rejected
